title: Fundamental IT Foundation
goal: Establish networking, operating system, hardware, Linux, and basic cybersecurity fundamentals.

title: Networking & Systems Engineering
goal: Move from basic IT knowledge into professional networking, Linux administration, automation, and infrastructure engineering.

title: Entry Cybersecurity
goal: Develop both defensive/SOC knowledge and introductory offensive-security capability.

title: Programming, Software & Secure Development
goal: Combine software engineering with secure software development, source control, CI/CD, and application security.

title: Initial Cloud Engineering
goal: Become competent in all three major cloud platforms while developing significantly deeper AWS knowledge.

title: Containers, Kubernetes & Infrastructure as Code
goal: Become capable of developing, deploying, administering, automating, and securing modern cloud-native infrastructure.

title: DevOps & DevSecOps
goal: Develop serious CI/CD, automation, SRE, infrastructure-as-code, and DevSecOps capability.

title: Offensive Security Foundation
goal: Transition from theoretical security knowledge into hands-on exploitation and penetration testing.

title: Advanced Offensive Security
goal: Reach advanced/expert competency in red teaming, web exploitation, defense evasion, Active Directory, and exploit development.

title: Defensive Security / Blue Team
goal: Become highly competent on the defensive side rather than becoming exclusively a red-team specialist.

title: Digital Forensics & Malware
goal: Add incident investigation, host/network forensics, malware analysis, and reverse engineering.

title: Advanced Penetration Testing Through GIAC
goal: Supplement OffSec's practical offensive-security path with SANS/GIAC's advanced offensive-security curriculum.

title: Cloud Security
goal: Combine your cybersecurity, software, Kubernetes, DevOps, and cloud knowledge into cloud-security engineering.

title: Advanced Cloud Architecture
goal: Progress from cloud engineer/security engineer into designing complex enterprise-scale cloud environments.

title: Advanced Network Security
goal: Reach expert-level networking and network-security engineering capability.

title: Data Engineering & Databases
goal: Add production-scale database, data pipeline, distributed data, and cloud data engineering competency.

title: AI & Machine Learning
goal: Add AI engineering, ML infrastructure, LLM development, and AI-security expertise.

title: Governance, Risk & Compliance
goal: Understand the legal, compliance, audit, privacy, governance, and risk side of cybersecurity.

title: Senior Cybersecurity
goal: Validate that you can operate beyond an individual technology and understand enterprise cybersecurity as an entire discipline.

title: Security Engineering & Architecture
goal: Transition from implementing security systems to designing entire secure enterprises.

title: Technical Leadership & Management
goal: Add engineering leadership, program management, Agile, project management, and cybersecurity-management capability.
